resources.string: While the phone is on one of these networks, the app opens without asking. Android needs the location permission to tell the network name.
Without the location permission the app can't tell which Wi-Fi network you're on.
No Wi-Fi network found. Connect to Wi-Fi and turn on location, then try again.
When the server is on your local network
The app opens without asking while the active server answers on the same Wi-Fi network as the phone. Reaching it through a VPN doesn't count.
